diagnostics.message: The template of the format slotted writes the slot '$code', which success.item does not fill.
diagnostics.fix: Use a slot of success.item (ADR 0002 sections 13 and 14), or write '$$code' for the literal text.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format broken is not valid: the text 'cost $5' writes a $ that starts no slot.
diagnostics.fix: Write $name for a slot, ${name} inside a longer text, $$ for a literal $, and { $each: $slot, $as: <template> } for an array.

diagnostics.message: The meta field 'user' of the format untyped is filled by 'handler', which gives it no type.
diagnostics.fix: Write the schema of 'user' beside its fill.

diagnostics.message: The error body of the format codeless writes no $code, so a client cannot tell the error.
diagnostics.fix: Write $code in the error body, as a member or inside a text ('https://errors.example.com/${code}'), or set 'conventions.errors.requireCode: false'.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format malformed is not valid: an array template is { $each, $as } and nothing else.
diagnostics.fix: Write $name for a slot, ${name} inside a longer text, $$ for a literal $, and { $each: $slot, $as: <template> } for an array.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format malformed is not valid: $merge takes one slot ($payload), without a member path.
diagnostics.fix: Write $name for a slot, ${name} inside a longer text, $$ for a literal $, and { $each: $slot, $as: <template> } for an array.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format malformed is not valid: the member name '$bad.key' is no slot (write $$ for a literal $).
diagnostics.fix: Write $name for a slot, ${name} inside a longer text, $$ for a literal $, and { $each: $slot, $as: <template> } for an array.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format leaky writes the slot '$payload', which an error body does not fill.
diagnostics.fix: Use a slot of an error body (ADR 0002 sections 13 and 14), or write '$$payload' for the literal text.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format statusMerge merges '$status', which holds no object.
diagnostics.fix: Merge an object slot ($payload, $meta, $fields), or write the slot as a member.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format eachMeta maps with $each '$meta', which holds no array.
diagnostics.fix: Map an array slot ($payload), or write the slot as a member.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format payloadKey names a member with '$payload', which holds no name.
diagnostics.fix: Name the member with a name slot ($collection), or write $$ for a literal $.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format unusedBad writes the slot '$nope', which success.item does not fill.
diagnostics.fix: Use a slot of success.item (ADR 0002 sections 13 and 14), or write '$$nope' for the literal text.

diagnostics.message: The paging style name none is reserved for a list served whole.
diagnostics.fix: Rename the style none.

diagnostics.message: The paging style twice writes no single position role.
diagnostics.fix: Write exactly one of cursor, page, offset and since, or the pair after and before.

diagnostics.message: The paging style nameless is not valid: its cursor role names no query parameter or header.
diagnostics.fix: Write query or header on the role.

diagnostics.message: The paging style split is not valid: its split sort names no direction parameter.
diagnostics.fix: Write direction on the sort role.

diagnostics.message: The page body of the paging style itemless writes $items nowhere.
diagnostics.fix: Write $items exactly once in response.body.

diagnostics.message: The paging style misfit pages by cursor, but writes the role $page, which only page, offset styles fill.
diagnostics.fix: Remove $page, or page by page or offset.

diagnostics.message: The link 'next' of the paging style linked is no URL role.
diagnostics.fix: Write one of $self, $first, $previous, $next, $last.

diagnostics.message: The paging style metaed adds meta members, but the page of the format bare writes no $meta.
diagnostics.fix: Write response.body on metaed, or use a format whose page writes $meta.

diagnostics.message: The paging style keyed is not valid: its keyed sort parameter 'sort' holds no {key}.
diagnostics.fix: Write {key} in the parameter name, as order[{key}].

diagnostics.message: The paging style directed is not valid: its sort names a direction parameter, which only style: split reads.
diagnostics.fix: Remove direction, or write style: split.

diagnostics.message: The paging style half writes no single position role.
diagnostics.fix: Write exactly one of cursor, page, offset and since, or the pair after and before.

diagnostics.message: The template of the paging style headed writes the slot '$code', which a paging style's meta, headers and links does not fill.
diagnostics.fix: Use a slot of a paging style's meta, headers and links (ADR 0002 sections 13 and 14), or write '$$code' for the literal text.

diagnostics.message: The paging style bodiless writes no single position role.
diagnostics.fix: Write exactly one of cursor, page, offset and since, or the pair after and before.

diagnostics.message: The meta member 'servedAt' is named by both the paging style clashing and the format stamped.
diagnostics.fix: Rename 'servedAt' in the style's meta or in the format's meta.

diagnostics.message: The paging style dup is not valid: its limit role sends the query parameter 'x', which another role sends too.
diagnostics.fix: Give each request role its own query parameter.

diagnostics.message: The paging style sinceprev pages by since, but writes the role $previous, which only cursor, page, offset styles fill.
diagnostics.fix: Remove $previous, or page by cursor or page or offset.

diagnostics.message: The paging style unusedBadStyle writes no single position role.
diagnostics.fix: Write exactly one of cursor, page, offset and since, or the pair after and before.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format ided writes $id, but the item of ided has no id property.
diagnostics.fix: Declare the id property on the item (or set idProperty), or use a format that reads no id.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format merged writes the member 'kind', which the merged $payload of merged defines too.
diagnostics.fix: Rename the property 'kind' of Note, or the template's member.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format merged merges $payload, but it holds no object for text.
diagnostics.fix: Answer an object from text, map an array with { $each: $payload, $as: <template> }, or use a format that wraps the payload.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format listMerge merges $payload, but it holds an array for lm.
diagnostics.fix: Answer an object from lm, map an array with { $each: $payload, $as: <template> }, or use a format that wraps the payload.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format arrMerge merges $payload, but it holds an array for am.
diagnostics.fix: Answer an object from am, map an array with { $each: $payload, $as: <template> }, or use a format that wraps the payload.

diagnostics.message: The template of the format itemMap maps $payload with $each, but it holds no array for im.
diagnostics.fix: Write $payload as a member, or use a format whose item shape maps no $payload.

diagnostics.message: The template of the paging style idless writes $itemId, but the item of idless has no id property.
diagnostics.fix: Declare the id property on the item (or set idProperty), or use a format that reads no id.
